interpretation: All 18 exposed-development worlds valid and eligible. Frozen retrieval meets the finite gain floor against fresh baseline and disabled control in all three groups, and beats shuffled proposals in two. Contextual feedback is correctly restricted, reused and changes decisions, but meets its benefit floor in no group and scores below frozen retrieval in all three. Influence remains unmatched. The longer horizon cannot establish causal improvement over the historical global-memory campaign. No held-out, noninferiority, superiority, recoverability or promotion authority.
